title: Evolution workflow must treat implementation, evidence and readiness as separate state
statement: The evolution process should be resumable from a universal trigger and should select the next contract from repository evidence rather than from conversational sequence. Contract progress is measured against explicit acceptance/evidence blocks. Implementation, verification evidence, and evolution readiness are separate statistics. Self-learning and self-optimization share one Candidate→Test→Verify→Shadow→Governance→Commit trust path. Directory optimization must remain read-only until duplicate identity, usage, protection, provenance and candidate binding are established.

engineering.consequence: Use contract-based autonomous task selection, separate Implementation/Evidence/Evolution Readiness metrics, and preserve the shared trust path for self-learning and self-optimization.
engineering.gap: CI and end-to-end provenance/audit integration for directory optimization remain to be verified.
